name: PR detail shows the seeded review run, verdict, findings, and the severity filter
description: From PR #482, open the Agent runs tab and confirm the seeded review run renders (verdict 'request changes', 2 findings) in its accordion header. The newest run's accordion is open by default (FindingsTab passes defaultOpen to the first run), so the VerdictBanner and the seeded FindingCard ('Hardcoded Stripe secret key in commit') are revealed without an extra click. Then exercise the per-run severity filter: the seed has exactly one CRITICAL and one WARNING (both above the low-confidence threshold, so `hide low confidence` never interferes), and picking CRITICAL must hide the WARNING while leaving the accordion and its '2 findings' header intact. Exercises ReviewRunAccordion / VerdictBanner / FindingsPanel / FindingCard / SeverityCounts. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
